text: {"lessons":["Selling winners just because they are above my average cost can make me miss further gains; I should judge each holding by its prospects, not whether its separate account shows a profit.","I should not let reluctance to admit a losing purchase keep me holding it; my average cost is not a reason to buy, sell, or hold.","With prices moving randomly, recent gains or declines do not predict what comes next; I should make decisions without relying on past price changes."]}
